item.title: A closer look at private company market readiness: Timing, priorities, and pain points
item.description: For private companies orchestrating a transfer or sale, fortune doesn’t favor the bold. It favors the prepared. A successful deal hinges on planning and foresight long before negotiations begin. To understand how private company leaders are positioning their businesses for that moment, we asked 100 executives about their upcoming timing, priorities, and pressure points.
